app.name: PKUDisk
app.expiredHint: Open PKUDisk from the tray or run pkudisk gui to get a fresh sign-in link.
app.stopped: The service has exited. Please close this window.
app.quitHint: Stop the desktop service. Finish transfers and unmount filesystems first.
app.noTray: System tray is unavailable. Use this page to quit the service.
app.quitMobileHint: Close the app and stop its local service. Finish transfers first.
app.stoppedMobile: The service is not running. Please exit the app.
app.stoppedUnknown: The service is not running. Please reopen the interface.

accounts.title: Your accounts
accounts.description: Connect campus accounts and switch between their libraries.
accounts.loginHint: Sign in with your PKU campus account. Credentials are saved privately on this computer.
accounts.label: Account name
accounts.labelHint: Leave empty to use your username
accounts.replace: Replace the saved login with this name
accounts.verifyHint: Enter the code requested by PKU authentication.
accounts.removeHint: This removes credentials from this computer. Remote files are kept.
accounts.emptyHint: Your document libraries will appear here after you connect an account.

files.title: My files
files.searchTruncated: Showing {count} of {total} matches. Refine the search to see more.
files.deleteHint: “{name}” will be moved to its library’s recycle bin.
files.emptyHint: Upload a file or create a folder to get started.
files.readOnlyHint: You have read-only access to this folder.
files.selectLibrary: Open a document library to upload or create folders.
files.pathHint: You can paste an absolute path or a path beginning with ~.
files.overwriteHint: Existing files are replaced only after the new transfer is validated. Other files are kept.
files.fastHint: Checks file hashes to reuse existing content when the server supports it.
files.extractHint: Server extraction may not preserve empty folders. Cancelling stops waiting; the server may continue.
files.copyHint: Copying within the same folder lets the server choose a new name.
files.noResultsHint: Try another search term or clear the filters.
files.selectFiles: Select files or a folder to upload
files.browserUploadHint: Keep this window open during the upload.
files.browserDownloadHint: Your browser saves the file. Find it in your downloads.
files.mobileUploadHint: Keep the app open during the upload.
files.browserFolderDownloadHint: Your browser saves this folder as a ZIP file.
files.mobileDownloadHint: Save to Downloads on your phone. Track progress in notifications.
files.mobileFolderDownloadHint: Save this folder as a ZIP file. Track progress in notifications.

tasks.title: Transfers & operations
tasks.description: Keep this window open during browser uploads. Downloads and other tasks can continue in the background while the local service is running.
tasks.emptyHint: Uploads, downloads and longer operations appear here.
tasks.cancelHint: Completed files are kept. Server-side copy or extraction may continue after cancellation.

mounts.title: Mounted drives
mounts.description: Use your netdisk from the system file manager and local applications.
mounts.rootHint: Leave empty to mount every library of the selected account.
mounts.allHint: Each account appears as its own top-level directory.
mounts.unmountHint: Save your work and close files using this mount first. Pending writes will be flushed.
mounts.emptyHint: Choose a local mountpoint and a document library to get started.
mounts.busyHint: The filesystem is still mounted. Close open files and retry unmounting.

drivers.unsupported: Filesystem mounting is unavailable on this platform. File browsing and transfers are still available.
drivers.linux: Enable /dev/fuse and install the fuse3 package. Choose an existing empty directory.
drivers.darwin: Install macFUSE and enable its kernel extension in System Settings. Choose an existing empty directory.
drivers.windows: Install WinFsp for your system architecture. Choose an unused drive letter or an empty directory.

mounts.localPathHint: Enter the local mount path. Browsers cannot expose the absolute path of a selected folder.

recycle.title: Recycle bin
recycle.description: Restore deleted items or remove them permanently.
recycle.restoreRename: Rename if a name conflict exists
recycle.emptyHint: Deleted files in this library will appear here.
recycle.removeHint: This cannot be undone. Only the items currently shown or selected will be removed.
recycle.restoreHint: Items return to their original locations.
recycle.selectLibrary: Choose a library to view its recycle bin.

history.title: Version history
history.restoreHint: The selected historical content becomes the current version.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.internalHint: Internal links require sign-in and existing access. Creating a link alone does not grant permissions.
sharing.externalHint: Anyone with a public link may access the item under its link settings.
sharing.revokeLinkHint: The link will stop working. The original file is kept.
sharing.grantConfirm: Grant access to the selected recipients?
sharing.createConfirm: Create a public link with these settings?
sharing.policyDefault: Default settings follow the server policy.
sharing.grantPartial: Access was granted, but link creation failed. Use “Get internal link” to retry.

recovery.title: Uncommitted writes
recovery.description: Inspect local writes retained after a failed upload, conflict or interrupted mount.
recovery.warning: Stop the affected mount before copying these files. Keep the originals until your recovered copy is verified.
recovery.emptyHint: Your cache has no uncommitted recovery records.
recovery.newNameHint: Use a new remote name when resolving a version conflict.
recovery.accountChanged: The original account has changed. Choose the correct account before uploading.
recovery.uploadHint: Choose this retained file in the browser, then upload it to its original remote folder.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceHint: Choose a language and color theme for this interface.
settings.sizesHint: Show exact bytes instead of readable units.
settings.desktopHint: Closing the browser keeps transfers and mounts running.
settings.accountStorage: Accounts and passwords are stored privately on this computer.
settings.mobileHint: View ongoing tasks on the Transfers page. Quitting the app stops the service.
settings.accountStorageMobile: Accounts and passwords are stored in this app’s private storage.

errors.title: Could not complete the operation
errors.operation_failed: The operation failed. Check the details and try again.
errors.busy: Finish or cancel active operations and unmount filesystems first.
errors.account_not_found: Choose an existing account or add one.
errors.account_exists: This account name already exists. Choose another name or enable replacement.
errors.not_found: The selected item could not be found.
errors.exists: An item with this name already exists.
errors.permission: You do not have permission for this operation.
errors.conflict: The remote file changed. Refresh before trying again.
errors.quota: The storage quota has been reached.
errors.size_limit: The server rejected this file size.
errors.approval_pending: The server requires approval. Access has not been granted yet.
errors.pickup_code: The server requires a pickup code.
errors.mount_unavailable: Install or enable the filesystem driver to mount a drive.
errors.network: Could not reach the desktop service. Open it again from the tray.

mobile.busy: Finish or cancel active tasks first.
mobile.network: Could not reach the service. Exit and reopen the app.
mobile.service_unavailable: The service is not running. Please exit the app.
mobile.mount_unavailable: This operation is unavailable in the app.

localPicker.title: Choose a local path
localPicker.description: Browse files and folders on the device running the service.
localPicker.emptyRequired: Choose an empty folder for mounting, or create a new one.
localPicker.backgroundHint: The service completes this transfer in the background.
